# Pull Request

## Description

A clear description of what this PR does and why.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Configuration change (templates or environment variables)
- [ ] Refactoring (code improvement without changing functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Testing

How have you tested these changes?

- [ ] Configuration renders without errors (`./scripts/render-config.bash`)
- [ ] Scripts execute successfully (tested locally or in Docker)
- [ ] Actual dstack deployment tested
- [ ] Service health check passes
- [ ] Documentation reviewed for accuracy

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows style guidelines (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md, example.env, comments)
- [ ] No sensitive information (API keys, tokens) in commits
- [ ] Changes maintain simplicity and educational focus
- [ ] Breaking changes documented (if applicable)

## Additional Context

Any other information, screenshots, or notes for reviewers.
